rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: Comparing the result of a typeof test against a string other than 'undefined', 'boolean', 'number', 'string', 'object', 'function' or 'symbol' is useless, since this comparison can never succeed.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: External links that open in a new tab or window but do not specify link type 'noopener' or 'noreferrer' are a potential security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: An attempt to use a value that is not an object or 'null' as a prototype will either be ignored or result in a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings
rules.description: Placing sensitive data in a GET request increases the risk of the data being exposed to an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A function is invoked with extra trailing arguments that are ignored.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Document Type Definition
rules.description: Parsing user input as an XML document with external entity expansion is vulnerable to XXE attacks.

rules.cwe_name: NULL Pointer Dereference
rules.description: Trying to invoke a value that is not a function will result in a runtime exception.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Interpreting unsanitized user input as code allows a malicious user arbitrary code execution.
